text_en: At my brother's request, I won't involve anyone else.
He trusts you completely, you see.
You best hurry back soon. I'm disobeying my orders to let General Brigard know about things like this for you.
I'm sorry about what happened earlier. I still haven't mastered this sort of spell, and I couldn't go back to my original form when I activated that trap.
Don't hold it against me, alright?
